description: Pop rising lava balloons before they float away — but NEVER pop a Fire Baby balloon! 60 seconds of fast-tap combo action.
fireSafetyLesson: Never let balloons or decorations touch hot lights or heaters — they can catch fire!
title: Ruko's Dash Blitz

description: The platforms are rising! Guide Boulder down through the gaps — don't get squished at the top. Fall as deep as you can!
fireSafetyLesson: Smoke rises! In a fire, STAY LOW under the smoke and crawl to safety!
title: Boulder's Rampart

description: Guide the light beam to the crystal! Tap mirrors to rotate them 45° and bounce light through 5 hand-designed puzzles.
fireSafetyLesson: Keep a flashlight by your bed — if the power goes out in a fire, light guides you out!
title: Cinder's Glide

description: Lord Inferno runs on his own — TAP to FLIP gravity! Run on the floor or the ceiling and dodge the spikes.
fireSafetyLesson: Never use elevators during a fire — always take the stairs!
title: Inferno Aim

description: TUG-OF-WAR against the Rock Golem! Mash the big button as fast as you can — pull the flag to your side. Best of 3!
fireSafetyLesson: In an emergency, work TOGETHER — teamwork keeps everyone safe!
title: Spark Jump Arcade

description: Spot 5 differences between two volcano scenes! Tap the difference on either side. 90 seconds on the clock!
fireSafetyLesson: Spot the dangers! Look for fire hazards in your home — frayed cords, overloaded outlets!
title: Lava Moat Defense

description: Slide the tiles to rebuild the Fire Baby picture! Tap a tile next to the empty space. Fewest moves wins!
fireSafetyLesson: Every piece matters — make a family fire escape plan where everyone knows their part!
title: Magma Drop Physics

description: Shooting gallery! Tap the rock targets to smash them — but NEVER shoot a Fire Baby! 45 seconds!
fireSafetyLesson: Know where the fire extinguisher is in your home — and never touch one without a grown-up!
title: Volcanic Stack Smash

description: HOLD to thrust UP — RELEASE to fall! Fly Cinder through the crystal caves without touching the walls!
fireSafetyLesson: Smoke rises to the ceiling — stay LOW and get out fast!
title: Fire Baby Rally

description: Guide the marble through 3 mazes! Drag anywhere — the marble rolls toward your finger. Reach the green goal!
fireSafetyLesson: Practice your home escape route — know two ways out of every room!
title: Caldera Bounce

description: Tap ONE ember to set it off — its blast triggers nearby embers in a chain reaction! Chain them ALL. 6 levels!
fireSafetyLesson: One tiny spark can start a huge fire — never play with matches or lighters!
title: Sizzle's Spark Run

description: A block swings at the top — tap DROP at the perfect moment to stack it! Perfect drops build combos. How high?
fireSafetyLesson: When the alarm sounds, timing matters — get out FAST, don't stop for toys!
title: Blaze's Inferno Roll

description: Ruko runs on his own — you handle the action! SHOOT fire bolts at rock enemies and JUMP over lava pits!
fireSafetyLesson: Run AWAY from fire — never toward it! Get out and stay out!
title: Ruko's Speed Trap
